title: Pentiment
why_relevant_visual: Manuscript-illumination art direction; typography that changes with each character's literacy and hand
what_to_study: Using script style as character evidence (handwriting = identity clue); paper/ink textures as UI
what_not_to_do: No copying of its illuminated style sheets, fonts or layouts; no screenshots in ATHAR materials
teen_suitability_note: Religious and political violence themes: style study only

title: Return of the Obra Dinn
why_relevant_visual: 1-bit dithered monochrome look that makes 'reading the scene' the core verb
what_to_study: Limited palette that forces attention to detail; logbook UI as case file
what_not_to_do: No dithering clone of its exact palette/UI; death tableaux are NOT an ATHAR pattern
teen_suitability_note: Each scene shows a death: unsuitable as content for 13-15

title: The Case of the Golden Idol
why_relevant_visual: Flat, crude-on-purpose illustration where every object is clickable evidence; fill-in-the-blank deduction board
what_to_study: How props are drawn to be legible clue-carriers on mobile
what_not_to_do: No copying of its character designs or deduction-board layout
teen_suitability_note: Steam blurb mentions 12 gruesome deaths: style reference only

title: Heaven's Vault
why_relevant_visual: Archaeology + glyph translation; hand-drawn 2D characters over 3D ruins; notebook UI
what_to_study: Translation-as-deduction visuals for ATHAR manuscript/cipher cases
what_not_to_do: No use of its invented script or UI assets

title: The Room
why_relevant_visual: Tactile close-up puzzle boxes, brass mechanisms, eyepiece lens that reveals hidden layers
what_to_study: Model for ATHAR lock/key/astrolabe props (Met padlocks and astrolabes as references)
what_not_to_do: No copying of box designs; avoid its occult/horror framing

title: Strange Horticulture
why_relevant_visual: Shop-counter identification game: labelled specimens, reference book, map
what_to_study: Identification-by-reference-book loop (De materia medica folios + Wellcome pharmacy jars as ATHAR equivalents)
what_not_to_do: Occult theme is not ATHAR's; no plant-identification of poisons as solution

title: The Roottrees are Dead
why_relevant_visual: Period web/archive UI (1998 internet) used as the evidence space; family-tree board
what_to_study: Archive-browsing UI for ATHAR 'Dar al-Sijill' and 'Tahaqquq' units
what_not_to_do: No copying of its family-tree board design

title: Sherlock Holmes Chapter One
why_relevant_visual: Mediterranean island city with mixed Ottoman/Levantine-style architecture; 'mind palace' deduction board
what_to_study: How a Mediterranean old town is built as a navigable investigation space — and how orientalist shortcuts creep in

title: Assassin's Creed Mirage (History of Baghdad codex)
why_relevant_visual: Reconstruction of 9th-c. Baghdad; codex pairs 66 sites with museum-credited artefact photos
what_to_study: Pattern: in-game artefact images with museum credit lines (ATHAR can do this with Met/Wellcome CC0/CC BY assets)
what_not_to_do: No screenshots or reconstructions reused; violence-centred gameplay is the opposite of ATHAR

title: The House of Hikmah
why_relevant_visual: Arab-developed adventure set in the House of Wisdom; one scholar per level (e.g., Ibn al-Haytham → optics)
what_to_study: Closest Arab-made visual neighbour to ATHAR's al-Manzar lab; study for differentiation and for audience expectations
what_not_to_do: Do not position ATHAR as a historical-scholar puzzle game (crowded niche now)
teen_suitability_note: Reported as grief-themed narrative; check rating before recommending

title: Paranormal (Ma Wara' al-Tabi'a)
owner_rights_holder: Netflix (based on novels by Ahmed Khaled Tawfik)
why_relevant_visual: 1960s Egypt period look: interiors, wardrobe, colour grading for an Arab mystery
what_to_study: Arab period-mystery production design and how audiences received it
what_not_to_do: Supernatural horror framing conflicts with ATHAR's 'superstition is a hypothesis to test' rule

title: Whispers (Wasawes)
why_relevant_visual: Contemporary Gulf family/corporate-mystery look: villas, offices, devices as evidence
what_to_study: Visual grammar of a family/corporate secret in a Gulf city (ATHAR 'al-Marsa')
teen_suitability_note: Plot starts from a death (off-screen premise): 16+ reference only; check platform rating

title: Rewayat Masreya lel-Geib (Egyptian Pocket Novels) covers
why_relevant_visual: Iconic painted pulp covers that shaped Arab teens' image of 'mystery' for decades
what_to_study: Nostalgia cues (typography/colour) that parents may recognise
what_not_to_do: Covers are copyrighted artworks: link only, never reproduce

title: Detective Conan (Case Closed) manga/anime
why_relevant_visual: Long-running detective manga/anime (serialised since 1994, >270 million copies) widely known to Arab audiences; clean anime look with diagram-style explanation scenes
what_to_study: Diagram-style explanation scenes (how the trick worked) as a teaching device
what_not_to_do: No character-like designs; murder-of-the-week content is above ATHAR's 13-15 ceiling
teen_suitability_note: Frequent on-screen deaths: content not suitable as model for 13-15
